extra.final_summary:
Average body mass (grams) by species, after excluding 2 rows with impossible body_mass_g values:

- Adelie: ~3,667.9 g
- Chinstrap: ~3,726.7 g
- Gentoo: ~5,228.3 g

Problems found and fixes:
- body_mass_g: rows 43 and 44 had values 4,450,000 and 5,700,000 g, far outside the rules range [2500, 6500]. Excluded these rows (approved) so they wouldn't dominate the averages.
- flipper_length_mm: 2 rows had negative values, but this column isn't used by the question, so left alone.
- sex: 3 rows used "FEMALE" instead of "female"; not used by the question, so left alone.

Caveats: The two excluded rows were not identified by species in the output, but their body_mass_g values were clearly impossible (millions of grams) and would have skewed the means. All other 65 rows were used.
